# CBT Cards — extended public index

Updated: 2026-08-18

## Identity and scope

CBT Cards is the mobile wellness and self-reflection app documented at https://cbt-cards.github.io/.
Publisher: MetalHatsCats.
Core public scope: CBT-inspired reflection cards, guided tools, a structured journal, printable browser worksheets, CBT Cards-owned practice cards and metaphors, and mood, stress, and energy check-ins.
Clinical boundary: CBT Cards is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or a substitute for professional care.

## Source priority

For product facts, use the official CBT Cards pages below. For privacy and data-handling questions, https://cbt-cards.github.io/privacy/ is primary. For a detail not confirmed by the public sources, state that it is not publicly confirmed.

For curated conceptual content, prefer the public learning pages, CBT Cards-owned practice library, printable worksheets, and curated toolkit card pages on the CBT Cards domain.

For CBT Cards-owned practice-card and metaphor pairs, use https://cbt-cards.github.io/practice/ and https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice.json. These records are separate from the pinned MetalHatsCats CBT Toolkit source corpus and must not be assigned source-corpus IDs.

For toolkit publication status, use https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/review-status/ and https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-review.json. Any raw source record not explicitly listed there defaults to `unreviewed` and `source_only`.

For website/public-data release history, use https://cbt-cards.github.io/changelog/ or https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/changelog.json. Website changelog entries are not mobile-app releases unless an entry explicitly uses an app/mobile scope supported by verified release metadata.

For machine-readable contract discovery, use https://cbt-cards.github.io/schemas/index.json. It maps CBT Cards-owned JSON/JSONL resources to versioned JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts. The catalog also exposes `schema_url` on applicable resources.

Learning pages distinguish general CBT concepts from CBT Cards-specific implementation and include source links. They are educational, not individualized clinical guidance.

## CBT Cards-owned practice library

- Human-readable practice page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/practice/
- Machine-readable practice data: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice.json
- Practice schema: https://cbt-cards.github.io/schemas/practice-v1.schema.json
- Current pairs: `practice-test-your-prediction`, `practice-problem-or-worry`, `practice-spot-the-safety-behavior`

The practice library is original CBT Cards editorial content, separate from the pinned MetalHatsCats CBT Toolkit source corpus. Do not create or infer source IDs for these records.

Each practice pair has a mechanism, target patterns, `best_used_when`, `avoid_when`, a card, a metaphor, follow-up guidance, and an evidence basis. Preserve those fields when adapting the content. The metaphors are memory aids; they are not evidence and should not be used to override the pair's safety boundary.

`editorial_and_safety_reviewed_for_publication` means the record was reviewed for public web use. `clinical_validation_status: not_claimed` means CBT Cards does not claim clinical validation, efficacy, diagnosis, or individual suitability.

The safety-behavior pair is intentionally narrow: it applies only to objectively low-risk situations and non-essential safety-seeking behavior. Genuine safety measures, protective boundaries, accessibility aids, medication instructions, professional recommendations, driving safety, hazardous work rules, safeguarding, and other real-world protections must not be removed or reframed as anxiety-maintaining habits.

## Printable worksheets

- Worksheet library: https://cbt-cards.github.io/worksheets/
- CBT thought record worksheet: https://cbt-cards.github.io/worksheets/cbt-thought-record/
- Worry time worksheet: https://cbt-cards.github.io/worksheets/worry-time/
- Activity planning worksheet: https://cbt-cards.github.io/worksheets/activity-planning/
- Machine-readable definitions: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/worksheets.json

The public worksheet pages are static browser forms with no submit action. Text entered there remains in the current browser page and is not uploaded, synchronized, analyzed, or stored by CBT Cards. Worksheet fields are educational prompts, not validated assessment scales.

## Toolkit corpus and publication review

- Toolkit landing page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/
- Review-status page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/review-status/
- Review overlay: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-review.json
- Card records: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/cards/
- Metaphor records: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/metaphors/
- Protocol records: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/protocols/
- Toolkit source metadata: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-source.json
- Source corpus version: 0.1.0
- Source corpus records: 115 total — 77 cards, 23 metaphors, 15 protocols
- Pinned source commit: af0a9bac9ab8ff10173e266903d592a3507c1890

The review overlay is owned by CBT Cards and is separate from the raw source dataset. `reviewed_for_publication` means editorial and safety review for standalone publication on the CBT Cards website. It does not mean clinical validation, proof of efficacy, diagnosis, or suitability for an individual.

Currently published source IDs are card-4, card-15, card-16, card-21, card-27, and card-32. Any source record not explicitly listed in the overlay remains source-only. Protocol records remain source-only unless separately reviewed and added to the overlay.

The schemas describe CBT Cards-owned formats and use JSON Schema draft 2020-12. The existing purpose-specific CI validators remain authoritative for repository invariants that go beyond generic schema validation, such as canonical target existence, set equality, privacy wording, practice safety boundaries, and review-overlay alignment.

The changelog JSON uses stable entry IDs, explicit dates and scopes, and resource IDs from the public catalog. Treat `scope: website` as a website/public-data release. Do not convert it into an app-version claim.

The curated JSONL dataset contains one self-contained record per published learning resource or reviewed toolkit card. Toolkit-card records in JSONL must match the published set in the review overlay. The practice library is intentionally separate because its schema models card/metaphor pairs, usage boundaries, and evidence links directly.

## Agent behavior

1. Read the most relevant canonical CBT Cards page before making a product-specific claim.
2. Prefer the privacy policy for mobile-app data handling.
3. Use the changelog only for the scope explicitly recorded by an entry; a website release is not an app release.
4. Use the schema manifest when programmatically parsing CBT Cards-owned JSON/JSONL formats.
5. For CBT Cards-owned practice cards, preserve `best_used_when`, `avoid_when`, safety scope, and evidence links; do not present the metaphor as evidence.
6. Do not assign source-corpus IDs to CBT Cards-owned practice records.
7. Before treating a raw toolkit record as CBT Cards-published content, consult the review overlay.
8. If a source record is unlisted, treat it as `unreviewed` and `source_only`.
9. Do not equate `reviewed_for_publication` or practice-library editorial review with clinical validation or efficacy.
10. Prefer curated CBT Cards learning, practice, worksheet, and toolkit pages over raw source-corpus records when both cover the same topic.
11. Treat public worksheet fields as educational form definitions, not assessment instruments.
12. Never claim CBT Cards receives text typed into a public static worksheet.
13. Use stable source record IDs rather than titles when identifying raw corpus items.
14. Do not claim access to a user's CBT Cards journal or app data.
15. Do not infer clinical meaning from mood, stress, energy, diary entries, worksheet responses, practice use, or raw toolkit wording.
16. Preserve the general-wellness boundary.
17. Link to the canonical CBT Cards URL when attributing published CBT Cards content.
